definitions.gloss: tea whisk; bamboo whisk used to prepare matcha
definitions.explanation: A small whisk carved from a single piece of bamboo, with fine tines splayed outward, used in the Japanese tea ceremony to whisk powdered green tea ({抹茶|まっちゃ}) into hot water. The splitting of the bamboo into many thin tines is what gives the whisk its characteristic shape and frothing ability.

examples.japanese: {茶筅|ちゃせん}で{抹茶|まっちゃ}を{点|た}てる。
examples.english: Whisk the matcha with a tea whisk.

examples.japanese: {茶筅|ちゃせん}は{使|つか}う{前|まえ}にお{湯|ゆ}で{湿|しめ}らせておく。
examples.english: Moisten the tea whisk with hot water before using it.

examples.japanese: {奈良|なら}{県|けん}の{高山|たかやま}は{茶筅|ちゃせん}づくりの{産地|さんち}として{知|し}られ、{職人|しょくにん}が{一本|いっぽん}の{竹|たけ}から{丁寧|ていねい}に{穂先|ほさき}を{割|わ}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: Takayama in Nara Prefecture is known as a production center for tea whisks, where artisans carefully split the tines out of a single piece of bamboo.

notes:
Compound of {茶|ちゃ} ('tea') and {筅|せん} ('whisk; brush'). The character {筅} is used almost exclusively in this word.

USAGE:
- Tightly associated with the tea ceremony ({茶道|さどう}). The whisk is one of the core utensils alongside {茶碗|ちゃわん} ('tea bowl'), {茶杓|ちゃしゃく} ('tea scoop'), and {棗|なつめ} ('tea caddy').
- The verb for using a tea whisk to prepare matcha is {点|た}てる, as in お{茶|ちゃ}を{点|た}てる ('to make tea [in the ceremonial way]'). Using {入|い}れる ('to brew') with {茶筅|ちゃせん} sounds unnatural.
- Number of tines varies by school and style: {数穂|かずほ} (many tines, ~80) for everyday use vs. fewer-tined whisks for thicker {濃茶|こいちゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶筅|ちゃせん}で{点|た}てる: to whisk (matcha) with a chasen
- {茶筅|ちゃせん}を{振|ふ}る: to move the whisk (in the whisking motion)
- {茶筅|ちゃせん}を{湿|しめ}らせる: to moisten the whisk
- {茶筅通|ちゃせんとお}し: the preparatory step of warming and inspecting the whisk
- {新品|しんぴん}の{茶筅|ちゃせん}: a brand-new tea whisk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {茶杓|ちゃしゃく}: tea scoop — the bamboo scoop used to measure matcha powder out of the caddy.
- {茶碗|ちゃわん}: tea bowl — in the tea ceremony, the bowl in which the matcha is whisked; in everyday life, also 'rice bowl'.
- {抹茶|まっちゃ}: matcha — the powdered green tea that is whisked with a {茶筅|ちゃせん}.
- {泡立|あわだ}て{器|き}: (ordinary) whisk — a Western-style wire whisk used in cooking; not a substitute for {茶筅|ちゃせん} in the tea ceremony.
